watch.note: Keep `transcribe.when: always`. On this platform a page's text is typically a heading plus the player — the video IS the content — so without a transcript the capture carries almost nothing. Point the watch at the section ROOT, not at a leaf: the prefix is derived from the URL you give, so a leaf-rooted watch rejects every sibling as out-of-scope while still exiting 0. Set the wiki's own `extract` block (content_selector / drop_selectors / title_selector) after the first capture — every HubSpot site themes differently.
